explanation: Statement: Line joining midpoints of two sides is parallel to 3rd side and half its length. Proof: Extend DE to F such that DE = EF. Triangle ADE congruent to CFE (SAS). AD = CF and AD || CF => DB = CF and DB || CF. DBCF is parallelogram, so DF || BC and DE = 1/2 BC.
